definitions.canonical: Existing corpus_sources(): 201 raw_eva files plus 43 additional LSI IDs.
definitions.lsi_preferred: Existing LSI selector: one preferred transcriber for each locus/line ID; no raw_eva whole-page aliases. A comparison dataset, not the committed recipe edition.
definitions.fully_resolved: Decoder label for rounded match score >= 0.70; permits unmatched residue.
definitions.partially_resolved: Decoder label for rounded match score >= 0.30 and < 0.70.
definitions.resolved: Sum of the two score classes; does not measure independently established translation accuracy.
definitions.stem_counts: Counts of emitted decomposition.stem.form only, not substring searches, reference-list entries, Latin-prefix matches, or recipe identifications.
definitions.empty_residue: No unmatched characters under the decoder's parse; no semantic-accuracy claim.
